name: Tropi Frutas
notes: No own site. Grubhub and Uber Eats/Postmates (same owner) both returned empty JS-shell pages on direct fetch - no server-rendered content to read without a browser pass. DoorDash listing (name typo "Tropi frutaa", but street address 342 West San Ysidro Boulevard, San Diego matches exactly) carries its full JSON-LD menu server-side: 91 raw items, of which 12 are an exact-name-duplicate "Most Ordered" featured section, leaving 79 unique priced items - not the ~91-item truncation pattern flagged in the brief. Markup test: 79/79 items (100%) already land on conventional endings (.95/.69) with no divisor beating 1.00, so no fee appears baked in. Cross-check: a Grubhub search snippet (page itself did not render) shows MILANESA TORTA at 4.95 vs DoorDash 5.95, a modest /6.7% gap consistent with ordinary platform variance rather than a markup pattern. SinglePlatform (place.singleplatform.com) has a full priced menu too but is visibly stale - its Super Acai Smoothie (.00/.00) and Tuna Salad (.95/.95) run well below the current Grubhub-snippet and DoorDash prices for the same items - so it was not used as the primary source. Licuados / Milk Shakes / Frappes / Fresh Waters / Natural Juice each list as a single base-priced line with flavor chosen as an unpriced modifier (matches SinglePlatform structure); recorded at that base price.

name: Two Hands Corn Dog Mira Mesa
notes: Own domain on file (ilovemiramesa.com) redirects to the same /.well-known/sgcaptcha/ bot-wall seen elsewhere in this batch - no content loads. This is a location of the Two Hands Corn Dogs chain (twohandsus.com); its own /online-order locations page links directly to order.online (https://order.online/business/~828142/) as the designated ordering platform for every branch, which promotes this from an independently-found white-label aggregator to the chain's own sanctioned ordering channel for this address (8111 Mira Mesa Blvd Ste B). order.online's server-rendered featured-items carousel gives 19 uniquely priced items covering corn dogs, sides, drinks and combo sets - markup test: 19/19 (100%) already conventional, no divisor beats raw 1.00, so no fee appears baked in on this source. Cross-check: Grubhub's search snippet shows the same items roughly 11-19% higher (Potato Dog .99+ vs .29, American Classic Dog .99+ vs .49, Two Hands Dog .89+ vs .79), consistent with an ordinary delivery-marketplace markup on top of the cleaner order.online price rather than any doubt about order.online itself. Uber Eats/Postmates (same owner) run higher still (Combo Set 4.99 vs 6.99 here) - same directional pattern. Confidence held at medium rather than high because only the featured-item carousel rendered server-side (a full category-by-category page needs JS), so a slush flavor or side not in the "most liked" carousel could be missing.
